notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="G5tdovCCYgw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]On the surface, he is a superhero, but his true identity is Brebeman, an up-and-coming DJ who rocks the night away. Brebeman travels around the world to protect the music of this world. He skillfully manipulates two discs to challenge the Sound Geists.[/p][p]A demo version was released in conjunction with Steam Nextf Fest June 2025 Edition, ahead of the release of the full game.The demo includes a tutorial, two stages, and a high-difficulty bonus stage. Worried that a music game might be too challenging? Don't worry—just give it a try, and before you know it, You'll be grooving to the beat and enjoying a thrilling gameplay experience. The game can be played using either a keyboard or a game controller. Choose your preferred setup and get ready to be hooked on breakbeats! [/p][p]Please give a warm welcome to the superhero Brebeman![/p]
